config_path.description: Top-level directory containing your mail (e.g., Maildir). Notmuch will recursively index it.

primary_email.description: Your main email address. Used to identify messages sent or received by you during threading.

other_emails.description: Additional email addresses you own. Improves threading by recognizing messages from/to these addresses as yours.

items.description: An additional email address you control.

aliases.description: Alternative names or identities you use (e.g., 'John Doe <john@work.com>'). Helps disambiguate sender identity.

new_tags.description: Tags automatically applied to newly added messages (e.g., ['inbox', 'unread']).

items.description: A tag to apply to new messages.

exclude_tags.description: Tags whose messages are excluded from default searches (e.g., ['trash', 'spam']).

items.description: A tag to exclude from search results.

trash_folder.description: Maildir folder name for trash (e.g., 'trash' or 'Drafts/trash'). Used by notmuch-show and hooks.

trash_remove_tags.description: Tags removed when moving messages to the trash folder (e.g., ['unread']).

items.description: A tag to remove when archiving to trash.

maildir_sync_flags.description: Whether to synchronize Maildir flags (e.g., 'F', 'S') with notmuch tags. Enable to keep sync with MUA.

git_enabled.description: Enable Git tracking of tag changes (writes .notmuch/git/ commits for history).

user_name.description: Your real name (optional, used in some UI contexts and email headers).

search_default_limit.description: Maximum number of messages to show in a single search listing.

search_default_sort.description: Default sort order for search results. Choose from: 'oldest_first', 'newest_first', 'date', 'from', 'subject'.

preserve_file_timestamps.description: If true, preserve original file timestamps during indexing; if false, update to current time.

user_tag_prefix.description: Prefix for user-defined tags to avoid conflict with system tags (e.g., 'user_' makes 'user_work' a user tag).

date_directory_format.description: Format used when generating date-based directories (e.g., for backup exports).

git_commit_template.description: Template for Git commit messages when tag changes are recorded (if Git is enabled).

db_path.description: Path to the Notmuch database directory. Usually left as default (~/.notmuch).

legacy_db_path.description: Path to an old database (if migrating). Only needed temporarily during upgrades.

maildir_sync.description: Legacy option (not used in modern Notmuch). Deprecated — keep false.
